caseNameFull: MARYLAND-NATIONAL CAPITAL PARK AND PLANNING COMMISSION v. AMERICAN HUMANIST ASSOCIATION

opinions.text: *452Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit granted. The case is consolidated and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.
